scorecard.promise: High-double digit growth in smartphone volume and 12-15% ASP growth.
scorecard.quote: we expect a high-double digit growth quarter-on-quarter in the smartphones volume along with growth in selling prices by 12% to 15%.
scorecard.outcome: Delivered. Q2 FY27 revenue grew 40% QoQ (₹15,548 Cr to ₹21,794 Cr), supporting high volume/value growth narrative.

scorecard.quote: we expect 20% to 25% volume growth quarter on-quarter growth as consumer demand strengthens
scorecard.outcome: Delivered. Total revenue grew 40.1% QoQ in Sep 2026, implying volume targets were likely met or exceeded.

scorecard.promise: Expand camera module capacity to 180-190 million units in 15-18 months.
scorecard.quote: expanding the capacities of camera module in subsidiary Q Tech... from 70 million annually to 180 million to 190 million annually over the next 15 to 18 months
scorecard.outcome: Tracking. In Nov 2026, management reaffirmed the 180-190 million unit target for the 'next fiscal'.

credibility.summary: Management shows strong execution on revenue and volume scaling but tends to be overly optimistic on infrastructure timelines, as seen with the Noida facility delays.

narrative_vs_numbers: Revenue growth consistently matches or exceeds the 'high double-digit' narrative, with Sep 2026 showing 47% YoY growth.
Operating margins (OPM) are tightening (2.7% in Sep 2026) despite management's narrative of maintaining 2.8%-3.2% in the core mobile segment.
Infrastructure timelines (Noida facility) have slipped from Q2 FY27 to Q3 FY27, diverging from earlier 'on track' statements.

calls.tone: Confident in long-term growth despite near-term macro headwinds and margin pressures.
